claims.claim: Rich-sorted source representation exceeds rich-unsorted under both supervision conditions on the new Round 2 source bank.
claims.allowed_wording: On the predeclared Round 2 source summary (1,414 E pairs / 389 parents), rich-sorted J3 exceeds rich-unsorted in all three model seeds under clean and flip supervision.
claims.forbidden_wording: Raw-prediction independently reproduced; cross-task confirmation; a learned set-network result; equal information in sorted and unsorted representations.
claims.denominator: Round 2 source: 1,414 E / 389 parents; three model seeds per supervision condition.
claims.recomputation: Seed-level arithmetic recomputed from saved metric rows in artifacts/submission_audit_20260925/routes/recomputed.json. Formal prediction recomputation NOT_RUN because per-case logits/correctness arrays are absent.
claims.limitations: This is one new source bank; metric summaries are not raw predictions. Sorting the two segment lengths and four cross distances is invariant under declared G8 permutations but is not shown to preserve all assignment information.

claims.claim: Expanded cross-task banks do not confirm transfer of the source sorted-representation advantage.
claims.allowed_wording: Round 2 T1 has 417 E / 170 parents and mixed or near-zero per-seed contrasts; T2 has 912 E / 361 parents and mixed contrasts. Neither confirms source ordering transfer.
claims.forbidden_wording: The source ordering is confirmed across tasks; T1/T2 replicate source; a universal repaired-interaction benefit.
claims.denominator: T1: 417 E / 170 parents; T2: 912 E / 361 parents; three model seeds and two supervision conditions.
claims.recomputation: Per-seed contrast arithmetic read from saved aggregate metrics; formal raw-prediction recomputation NOT_RUN because per-case logits/correctness arrays are absent.
claims.limitations: Summary-level verification only; this does not prove a null effect or mechanism absence.

claims.claim: The area-pooled fresh visual run shows no stable interaction-head advantage over direct; a matched-exposure clean-only comparison shows higher same-bank J3 for direct training on all singleton labels.
claims.allowed_wording: On 28 quartets / 19 parents, direct J3 was 0.571/0.607/0.536 and interaction J3 was 0.321/0.571/0.536 in v3. The exposure-matched clean-only reference had J3 0.143/0.250/0.214; direct-minus-clean paired deltas were +0.429/+0.357/+0.321 with within-seed parent-cluster intervals excluding zero.
claims.forbidden_wording: A visual interaction structure wins; a general visual mechanism result; 28 quartets or 3 seeds are independent parent-level replications; the old 0.155 lower-exposure baseline establishes a clean-vs-flip effect.
claims.denominator: Fresh bank: 28 quartets / 19 parents. Main and matched clean-only each used 3 seeds, 20 epochs, 323 training presentations per epoch, 81 singleton dev examples for checkpoint selection, and the same data archive/init per matched seed. Clean-only used 128 unique train rows repeated to 323 presentations.
claims.recomputation: J3/J4/atomic/CCM recomputed from v2, v3, and matched-static archived NPZ predictions with exact label/parent equality checks. Within-seed parent-cluster bootstrap used 10,000 resamples over 19 parents. For clean-to-direct flows: baseline 110 counts 16/12/12; full repairs 10/9/5; migrations 1/1/3; endpoint gains 11/10/8; gains equal repairs plus migrations in every seed.
claims.limitations: Only 19 parent clusters and 28 quartets; three model seeds share one bank. Equal presentation count does not equal unique-example count. The confidence intervals are within-seed parent-cluster intervals, not a three-seed population interval. Interaction-minus-direct J3 remains unstable or nonpositive in v3.
fixes: J4 now includes P correctness in gpu_run.py, static_baseline.py, and recompute_from_predictions.py; legacy output files were not rewritten.
Area pooling is the future default; nearest remains explicit for historical replay, and actual pool is recorded in run_config, result, and checkpoint metadata.

The future clean-only comparison repeats clean indices to the main arm's per-epoch presentation count and defaults to all-singleton dev selection; clean-only dev selection remains an explicit CLI option.

claims.forbidden_wording: An independently recomputed parser score; visual image parsing; the learned relation model solved source geometry; broad parser generalization.

claims.recomputation: NOT_RUN for formal E banks because bank states and per-case parser predictions are not archived. The small source-parser contract tests cover crossing, separation, and declared endpoint-swap invariance only.
claims.limitations: The first report's 142-parent entry conflicts with stored metadata; source parent is the test-scene row index and the artifact has 65 unique indices. The second bank is a separate round, not a pooled denominator.
fixes: Correct denominator is 65, not 142; the report erratum is recorded in the audit. No historical result JSON was edited.

claims.claim: Route 4 aggregate summaries report that the rich-sorted versus rich-unsorted direction persists under canonical, translation, and rotation coordinates on a low-budget fresh source bank.
claims.allowed_wording: The saved Route 4 summary reports E=207 / 66 parents and preserves the sorted-versus-unsorted direction under canonical, +(.071,-.043) translation, and 7-degree rotation conditions after 60 epochs.
claims.forbidden_wording: Visual-renderer robustness; noise robustness; a reproduced raw-prediction effect; a high-power or high-budget confirmation.

claims.recomputation: Formal scores NOT_RUN: no per-case logits/correctness arrays are archived. Focused tests verify oracle labels on a crossing example under translation/rotation; this is a transform contract check, not a performance rerun.

The focused regression checks oracle-label invariance, not shape alone.

claims.claim: The specific G8-sorted rich-feature processing improves single-flip J3 over the same unsorted feature quantities in the archived coordinate-structure experiment.
claims.allowed_wording: On the saved 2,188 E / 871-parent structure bank, rich8_sorted minus rich8_unsorted single-flip J3 is about +0.061 to +0.092 over five seeds, with all five parent intervals excluding zero. The operation is a concrete invariant sort, not evidence of equal information or a learned set model.
claims.forbidden_wording: Sorted and unsorted inputs contain exactly equal information; sorting is a learned architecture; midpoint/angle effects are isolated; cross-task or visual transfer is established.
claims.denominator: 2,188 E / 871 parents; five model seeds; parent-cluster intervals.
claims.recomputation: NOT_RUN from raw predictions: only per-seed aggregate J3 and parent bootstrap summaries are archived.
claims.limitations: The sort can discard value-to-role assignments. The unplanned midpoint/angle contrast is not resolved by this comparison.

claims.claim: Replacing the additive segment-sum's final linear readout with a small nonlinear readout yields a modest clean-supervision increase but does not recover high single-flip J3.
claims.allowed_wording: On 2,188 E / 871 parents, repaired-rho minus additive clean J3 gains are about +0.012 to +0.032 with all five reported intervals excluding zero; under flip supervision three of five intervals include zero and repaired J3 remains about 0.017–0.046.
claims.forbidden_wording: The nonlinear readout explains the sorted geometry gain; the repaired model solves composition; the repair is a generally effective method.
claims.denominator: 2,188 E / 871 parents; five model seeds for the continued contrast.
claims.recomputation: NOT_RUN from per-quartet predictions; archived evidence consists of aggregate metrics and parent-bootstrap contrasts.
claims.limitations: This only compares one rho repair against its additive negative control; it does not explain the larger feature-sort contrast.
